reason: Verified per-site (RFC 0106): calculations.rb:569 is `calculated_data.column_types.fetch(aliaz, Type.default_value)`. A JS record has no `fetch`, so the port spells Hash#fetch's key-presence semantics with `Object.hasOwn` (a stored value wins over the default even when it is null) — same behaviour, no call the extractor can see.
